items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: And I used to hear this George Lewis too when he won the parade, too.

ctx.x: Yeah, I used to hear him in those walking parades. And I used to hear this George Lewis too when he won the parade, too. Because I think at that time he was playing E-flat clarinet. I don't know whether he's playing E-flat, no, no.
He fell out, as he says, in the parade about four years ago. Oh, is that? The sun got him out, almost like a sunstroke. He hasn't played hardly a parade since.
